notes.title: Playtest Update 0.2.0.2
notes.content:
This update features many needed accessibility features. These were a major hurdle!

Steam Next Fest is upon us and hopefully many new players! Please provide feedback on the game, there is a new shorter feedback form accessible from the game. Further, more final, development plans are made shortly after the Next Fest.

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]

[h3]General:
[/h3]Added text size options.
Added UI scaling options.
Added some resolution options.
Added ability to toggle full screen.

[h3]Gameplay:
[/h3]Added a new Talk option when meeting with Seekers with Ignored or better attitude. This allows the player to use Movement to gain Spirit.
Enhanced weapon tooltips to be more clearer.
Added a new display to show previous turn events on both sides.
‘Fangs gain Howl a bit later, making starting maps less of a slog.

[h3]Bugfixes:
[/h3]Fixed a slowdown issue on long game sessions.


Good gaming!

notes.title: Playtest Update 0.1.5.7
notes.content:
This update feature many small improvements to UI and useability behaviours. Notably an issue with tooltip delays is now fixed.

[h3]General:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed some weird behaviour and delays with tooltips.
[*] Added Tooltip Delay option.
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New item tag: Salvo: This item does not end the turn when used in the first turn in battle. Does not apply for enemies (for now).
[*] All Grenades now have the Salvo tag.
[*] Fire Elemental melee damage reduced.
[*] Mirroin Mantra -5 Defence.
[*] Mirrions no longer attack from Dormant Devices and Weapon Fragments.
[/list]

[h3]QOL:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a small graphical notifier for when the player has unlocked new game start options (Seeker, Guide or Difficulty).
[*] Improved many UI tooltips.
[/list]
